paste_masks_in_image: paste a set of fixed-resolution masks into an image using bounding boxes to determine placement
paste_mask_in_image_old: paste a single mask into an image using bilinear resizing and binarization with a threshold
pad_masks: pad a batch of masks with zero cells on all sides and return the scale factor
scale_boxes: scale a batch of bounding boxes by a given factor while preserving their centers
do_paste_mask: paste multiple masks into an image region using grid sampling with optional empty region skipping
